βέλεα: βέλος — missile, arrow; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic βέλη)
βαλλόμενος: βάλλω — throw, hit; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’being struck’
βιοῖο: βιός — bow; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ); a poetic word = τόξον, not βίος ’life’
βολῇσιν: βολή — throw, missile; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς): ’with throws’
βρότον: βρότος — gore, blood from a wound; masc. acc. sg. (not βροτός ’mortal’)
γνωτὸν: γνωτός — known, plain (verbal adj. of γιγνώσκω); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’known, plain’
γοάοιεν: γοάω — wail, lament; pres. opt. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic γοῷεν): ’would lament’
θέε: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἔθει): ’ran’
θανόντων: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’of the dead, having died’
κατέβαν: καταβαίνω — go down; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic κατέβησαν): ’they went down’
κατθέμενοι: κατατίθημι — lay down, lay out; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., with apocope (κατθ- = κατα-θ-): ’having laid out’
κεύθεσι: κεῦθος — hiding-place, depth; neut. dat. pl., chiefly plural: ’in the hiding-places’
κλίσιον: κλίσιον — shed (a working guess; the exact structure is not known; from the root of κλίνω ’lean’); neut. nom. sg.
κομέεσκεν: κομέω — tend, care for; impf. 3 sg., iterative in -σκ-, uncontracted (= Attic ἐκόμει): ’used to tend’
κουριδίου: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a husband or wife); masc. gen. sg.
κτεάτισσεν: κτεατίζω — acquire, win; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic double σ (= Attic ἐκτεάτισε)
κτείνασα: κτείνω — kill; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having killed’
κτεῖνον: κτείνω — kill; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔκτεινον): ’were killing’
λέξαιτο: λέγω (mid.) — pick out, choose; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., potential with κεν: ’could pick out’
μέλανα: μέλας — black, dark; masc. acc. sg.
μέμνημαι: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember; perf. 1 sg. mid. with present sense: ’I remember’
μέμνητ: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember; perf. 3 sg. mid., elided, present sense (μέμνητ’ = μέμνηται): ’she remembers’
μέμνῃ: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember; perf. 2 sg. mid., present sense (= μέμνησαι): ’you remember’
μαχεούμενοι: μάχομαι — fight; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μαχόμενοι): ’fighting’
μηνὶ: μείς (epic μήν) — month; masc. dat. sg., dat. of time: ’in a month’
μνώμεθ: μνάομαι — woo, court; impf. 1 pl. mid., unaugmented and elided (μνώμεθ’ = μνώμεθα; Attic ἐμνώμεθα): ’we were wooing’
νοός: νόος (Attic νοῦς) — mind, purpose; masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νοῦς); the edition puts the accent on the ending (νοός)
οὔλῳ: οὖλος (Ionic; = Attic ὅλος) — whole, entire; masc. dat. sg.: ’a whole (month)’
πάϊ: παῖς (epic πάϊς) — child, son; masc. voc. sg. (= Attic παῖ)
παρπεπιθόντες: παραπείθω — win over, persuade; aor. 2 part. act. masc. nom. pl., reduplicated, apocope (παρπεπιθόντες = παραπεπιθόντες; Attic παραπείσαντες)
περήσαμεν: περάω — cross, pass over; aor. 1 pl., epic η, unaugmented (= Attic ἐπεράσαμεν): ’we crossed’
περιταμνομένους: περιτάμνω (Attic περιτέμνω) — cut off round about, drive off (cattle); pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’cutting off’
πλύνασ: πλύνω — wash; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (πλύνασ’ = πλύνασα): ’having washed’
πολλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πολλ’ = πολλά), adverbial: ’very much’
πολυκερδείῃσιν: πολυκερδείη — alertness to gain, shrewdness (cf. πολυκερδής ’many-gained’); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις): ’by many-gainful ways’
προγενέστεροι: προγενής — born before, older; comparative προγενέστερος, masc. nom. pl.: ’older’
προφανέντ: προφαίνω — show forth; aor. pass. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (προφανέντ’ = προφανέντα): ’appearing, having appeared’
σικελὴ: Σικελός — Sicel, of the Sicels; fem. nom. sg. Σικελή
σιτέσκοντο: σιτέομαι — eat, feed; impf. 3 pl. mid., iterative in -σκ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐσιτοῦντο): ’used to eat’
σώματ: σῶμα — body (in Homer, usually a corpse); neut. nom. pl., elided (σώματ’ = σώματα)
φραζομένη: φράζω — show; mid. plan, devise; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’planning’
χαλεπὴν: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous; fem. acc. sg.
ἀγορεύοι: ἀγορεύω — speak, say; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a concessive condition after εἰ: ’(even if) he should say’
ἀμφίμεδον: Ἀμφιμέδων — Amphimedon, one of the suitors; masc. voc. sg.
ἀμφιμέδοντος: Ἀμφιμέδων — Amphimedon, one of the suitors; masc. gen. sg.
ἀμύμονι: ἀμύμων — blameless (the real sense is not known); fem. dat. sg. (two-ending adj.)
ἀναγκαῖοι: ἀναγκαῖος — of compulsion, forced, constrained; masc. nom. pl.
ἀπονίψαντες: ἀπονίζω — wash off; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having washed off’
ἀργαλέους: ἀργαλέος — grievous, harsh, troublesome; masc. acc. pl.
ἀρτύναντε: ἀρτύνω — prepare, contrive, arrange; aor. part. act. masc. nom. dual: ’the two having prepared’
ἐκλήϊσεν: κλήϊζω (κλῄω) — shut, bar; aor. 3 sg., epic form (= Attic ἔκλῃσεν): ’shut’
ἐκτήσω: κτάομαι — acquire, win; aor. 2 sg. mid.: ’you acquired’
ἐνίσσομεν: ἐνίσσω (ἐνίπτω) — rebuke, abuse; impf. 1 pl., epic by-form (= Attic ἐνίπτομεν): ’we rebuked’
ἐνισσόμενος: ἐνίσσω (ἐνίπτω) — rebuke, abuse; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’being rebuked’
ἐπιτάρροθος: ἐπιτάρροθος — helper, ally (formation obscure); masc. nom. sg. (two-ending adj. used as noun)
ἐργάζοντο: ἐργάζομαι — work, labour; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἠργάζοντο)
ἐρεμνὴν: ἐρεμνός — dusky (not μέλας ’dark’); fem. acc. sg., epic (cf. Attic ἐρεβεννός)
ἐτελεύτα: τελευτάω — bring to an end, accomplish; impf. 3 sg.: ’was bringing to an end’
ἐτόλμα: τολμάω — dare, endure, hold out; impf. 3 sg.: ’held out’
ἐφίει: ἐφίημι — send at, let fly at; impf. 3 sg.: ’was sending at, kept sending’
ἐϋσσέλμων: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched (of ships); fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic εὔσελμος)
ἑοῖσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive; Homeric ἑός, = Attic ἑαυτοῦ, ἴδιος) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις); not the relative
ἔδυτε: δύω (δύνω) — enter, go into, sink; aor. 2 pl. root aorist (same in Attic), + acc.: ’you entered’
ἔπεσίν: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl. (= ἔπεσι), accent thrown back by the following enclitic τε
ἔσσετ: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic ἔσσεται (= Attic ἔσται), elided (ἔσσετ’): ’will be’
ἠρνεῖτο: ἀρνέομαι — refuse, deny; impf. 3 sg.: ’was refusing’
ἡμείων: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; gen. pl., epic ἡμέων/ἡμείων (= Attic ἡμῶν): ’of us’
ἵζανον: ἱζάνω (ἵζω) — sit, seat oneself; impf. 3 pl.: ’they sat’
ὀλεῖται: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; fut. 3 sg. mid., contracted (ὀλέεται): ’will perish’
ὀπάσσει: ὀπάζω — bestow, grant, give as companion; fut. 3 sg., epic double σ (= Attic ὀπάσει): ’will bestow’
ὀτρυνέων: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; fut. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀτρυνῶν), of purpose: ’to urge on’
ὁμήλικες: ὁμήλιξ — of an age with, age-mate; masc. nom. pl.
ὁμοκλέομεν: ὁμοκλέω — shout at, call out threateningly; impf. 1 pl., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ὡμοκλοῦμεν)
ὑμέτερον: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.); neut. acc. sg. (agreeing with δῶ ’house’)
ὑφήνασα: ὑφαίνω — weave; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having woven’
ὕστερος: ὕστερος — later, last (comparative); masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’later, behind’
ὠτειλέων: ὠτειλή — wound; fem. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠτειλῶν)

__broaden__.δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι, used as imperative: ’give’ · also inf. after ὀτρύνω, ’to give’ (πομπὴν ὀτρύνω δόμεναι ’I urge (him) to give a conveyance’) · also inf. complementing an impersonal ’it seemed better’: ’to give’ (κέρδιον εἶναι … δόμεναι ’better to give’) · also inf. after the impersonal χρή: ’to give’ (σε χρὴ δόμεναι ’you ought to give’) · also inf. complementing ἔτλης: ’to bring oneself to give’ · also inf. after φθονέω: ’(do not) begrudge giving’ (οὔτε τινὰ φθονέω δόμεναι) · also inf. after ἐάω, ’to give’ (οὐκ ἐάσουσιν … δόμεναι ’they will not allow (it) to be given’) · also inf. complementing ἐθέλω, ’(if I) wish to give’ (αἴ κ’ ἐθέλωμι … δόμεναι) · also inf. after ὁμοκλέομεν, negated by μή: ’(shouted) not to give’ (τόξον μὴ δόμεναι)
__broaden__.κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + aor. indic., unreal past: κέν μοι … κατέχευας ’you would have poured on me’ · also + subj. in a main clause: ’may’ (καί κέν οἱ ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα ’and he may hold his hand over him’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (κέν μοι … εἴη ’would be mine’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέν τις … ὀρέξῃ ’if perhaps someone holds out’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν … μεταλλῶσιν ’whenever they ask’) · also + opt., potential, in a clause with ὅ ’that’: ’might’ (ὅ κέν τις … ἀμύνοι ’that someone might defend’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … would’ (ὥς κέν τις φαίη ’so that anyone would say’) · also + subj. in a clause with εἰς ὅτε, ’until the time when’ (εἰς ὅτε κέν … καθέλῃσι)
__broaden__.κακοῖσιν: κακός — bad, base; used as noun ’the bad’; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις) · also attributive adj. agreeing with a noun: ’evil’ (ἔπεσιν κακοῖσιν ’with evil words’)
__broaden__.κακός: κακός — bad, base, poor; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’bad, poor’ · also masc. nom. sg., attributive with a noun: ’evil’ (κακός … δαίμων ’some evil power’)
__broaden__.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: κακὸν … βάζειν ’(it is) bad to speak’ · also neut. acc. sg. governed by ἐς: ’into evil’ (ἐς κακὸν … βάλῃσθα) · also neut. acc. sg. subject of an infinitive: ’an evil’ (κακὸν ἔμμεναι ’that an evil is’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of εἴη: ’evil’ (μή τι κακὸν … εἴη ’and may no evil be’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ῥάκος: ’vile’ (ῥάκος ἄλλο κακὸν ’another, a vile rag’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a finite verb: ’an evil’ (ἐπεὶ κακὸν ἔμπεσεν οἴκῳ ’since an evil fell upon the house’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενοίμην: ’a bane, an evil (to them)’ · also masc. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’a base man’ (κακὸς κακὸν ἡγηλάζει) · also masc. acc. sg., attributive with θάνατον: ’evil’ (θάνατον … κακόν ’evil death’) · also masc. acc. sg., in apposition to τινα: ’bad (man)’ (οὐ κακὸν οὐδὲ … ἐσθλόν ’neither bad nor good’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., attributive with τέλος: ’evil’ (κακὸν τέλος ’evil end’)
__broaden__.κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’young men!’ (κοῦροι ἐμοὶ μνηστῆρες)
__broaden__.πηνελοπείῃ: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope; dat. sg., dat. of comparison · also dat. sg., indirect object: ’to Penelope’ (ἐρέοντα περίφρονι Πηνελοπείῃ ’to tell prudent Penelope’) · also dat. sg. in apposition to a preceding dative of the person affected: ’(the daughter of Icarius,) prudent Penelope’ · also dat. sg. of possession/reference with a noun and εἰμί: ’in, of Penelope’ (ἀγαθαὶ φρένες ἦσαν … Πηνελοπείῃ ’Penelope’s wits were good’) · also dat. sg. of advantage: ’for (sound-minded) Penelope’ (ἐχέφρονι Πηνελοπείῃ)
__broaden__.ἐναλίγκιον: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the speaker: ’like (a beggar)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the object ἄνακτα: ’like (a beggar)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the relative ὅν (subject of εἶναι), + dat.: ’like (the gods)’ (θεοῖς ἐναλίγκιον) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with φᾶρος ’robe’, + dat.: ’like (the sun)’ (ἠελίῳ ἐναλίγκιον)
__broaden__.ἐτελέσθη: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been brought to pass’ · also aor. pass. 3 sg. with a neut. pl. subject, of time: ’were brought round to their end’ (ἤματα πόλλ’ ἐτελέσθη)
__broaden__.ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’) · also pron. ’he’, masc. nom. sg. (ἧος ὃ … μιγείη) · also neut. acc. sg. relative, referring back to a thing, object of δῶκας: ’which (you gave me)’ · also = ὅτι ’that’, neut. acc. sg., introducing a clause after a verb of knowing (ὃ δὴ κακὰ μήδετο ’that evils were being devised’) · also neut. nom. sg. relative of a thing, subject of ἐστι: ’that which, whatever’ (ὃ κάλλιστον … ἐστι ’the one that is fairest’) · also neut. acc. sg. relative as a connective, ’for which reason, which is why’ (ὃ καὶ μεταμώνια βάζεις ’which is why you speak idly’) · also neut. nom. sg., demonstrative/connective, subject of ἐστί: ’that’ (ὃ γὰρ γέρας ἐστί ’for that is the due’)
__broaden__.ἑσταότ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότα, Attic ἑστηκότα): ’standing’ · also perf. part. masc. nom. dual, elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότε): ’the two standing’
